job.title: Bakery Manager
job.description:
The Opportunity
We are seeking a dynamic, energetic and results-driven Bakery Manager to take ownership of a growing bakery operation.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can raise standards, bring professionalism and structure to the team, and make a genuine impact on business performance. You will lead from the front, combining strong people leadership with hands-on involvement on the production floor.
The successful candidate will be ambitious, engaging and commercially minded, with the energy and resilience to challenge the status quo, drive improvements and help build a high-performing operation.
Key Responsibilities
· Take ownership of the safe, efficient and effective day-to-day running of the bakery.
· Lead, motivate, coach and develop the bakery team, setting clear expectations and high standards.
· Plan labour, rotas and resources to deliver production targets on time and to specification.
· Maintain excellent standards of food safety, hygiene, quality and Health & Safety.
· Monitor KPIs including output, efficiency, downtime, waste, yield and labour utilisation.
· Identify operational issues, conduct root cause analysis and implement practical improvements.
· Work closely with Production, Engineering and Technical/Quality to improve reliability, efficiency and processes.
· Develop and maintain effective SOPs, work instructions and standard ways of working.
· Recruit, train and develop operators as the team grows.
· Take ownership of problems and drive them through to resolution.
Experience & Skills
Essential:
· Food manufacturing experience, ideally within a bakery or dough-based environment.
· Proven experience leading or supervising production teams.
· Strong knowledge of food safety, hygiene and Health & Safety.
· Experience working to production plans, KPIs and operational standards.
· Strong practical problem-solving and continuous improvement skills.
· Excellent leadership, communication and interpersonal skills.
· Confident challenging ineffective processes and driving change.
· A genuinely hands-on approach to production.
Desirable: Experience with automated production lines, Lean/continuous improvement, SOP development, Engineering/Maintenance collaboration and production scale-up.
The Person
We are looking for someone who:
· Leads from the front and sets high standards.
· Is dynamic, energetic, resilient and results-oriented.
· Is engaging and confident, with the ability to inspire and develop people.
· Takes ownership and turns problems into solutions.
· Is practical, commercially aware and focused on continuous improvement.
· Wants to make a real mark on the business and drive growth, rather than simply maintain the status quo.
The role requires someone to cover 4 days per week on a 12 hour shift (5am to 5pm), and whilst the operation runs from Saturday to Thursday (core days being Sunday to Thursday) flexibility will be required to work additional hours when required, however any additional hours in excess of the standard 48, will be paid at time and a half.
Success in the Role
Success will be demonstrated through safe and reliable production, consistently high quality and hygiene standards, improved efficiency and productivity, reduced waste and downtime, and a capable, engaged and increasingly self-sufficient bakery team.
This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of a growing operation, raise the bar and play a key role in its future success.

job.title: Head of Transport
job.description:
The Role
We are a family-run, privately owned business built on strong relationships, operational excellence, and a genuine pride in the service we deliver. Our success has been built by combining a personal approach with professional standards - giving our customers the reliability of a major logistics provider, while retaining the agility, responsiveness, and care that sets us apart.
We are looking for an experienced, commercially minded Head of Transport to take full ownership of our transport operation and become a key member of our leadership team.
This is a career-defining opportunity for a transport professional who wants more than a traditional management role. You will have the autonomy to influence strategy, drive operational improvement, and shape the future of our transport function as the business continues to grow.
You will be responsible for leading the complete transport operation - setting standards, improving performance, controlling costs, developing people, and creating a culture where accountability, professionalism, and respect are at the heart of everything we do.
At our business, decisions are made quickly, ideas are valued, and experienced people have the opportunity to make a visible impact. Unlike larger, more complex organisations where change can be slow, you will have the ability to identify opportunities, implement improvements, and see the results of your leadership.
You will play a critical role in ensuring our transport operation remains efficient, compliant, customer-focused, and commercially aligned, while supporting our ambition to deliver exceptional service and build long-term partnerships with our customers.
Key Responsibilities
· Take full ownership of the transport operation, including service delivery, operational performance, cost control, and continuous improvement.
· Lead, develop, and inspire the transport and driving teams, creating a culture of accountability, engagement, ownership, and high standards.
· Build strong relationships with drivers and operational colleagues, ensuring people feel valued, supported, and respected.
· Drive transport efficiency by identifying opportunities to improve utilisation, reduce empty running, optimise resources, and maximise fleet performance.
· Own transport cost management, challenging inefficiencies and implementing commercially focused solutions.
· Lead transport planning strategy, ensuring resources are aligned with customer requirements and operational demands.
· Take full responsibility for operator licence compliance, driver standards, working time regulations, and all relevant transport legislation.
· Use data, reporting, and KPIs to understand performance, drive improvements, and create a culture of continuous development.
· Lead the transport element of customer onboarding, ensuring operational solutions are well planned and delivered successfully from day one.
· Develop strong partnerships with customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring we continue to be recognised as a trusted logistics partner rather than simply a service provider.
· Act as a visible and approachable leader who engages with the operation, solves problems quickly, and sets the benchmark for professional standards.
· Bring fresh thinking, challenge existing processes, and identify opportunities to improve the way we operate.
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for a proven transport leader who combines operational expertise with commercial understanding and the ability to inspire people.
You will have:
· Proven experience in a senior transport leadership role within a demanding operational environment.
· International CPC qualification (mandatory), with experience holding or supporting Operator Licence responsibilities.
· A strong track record of improving transport performance, controlling costs, and delivering operational efficiencies.
· Experience leading planning functions and improving fleet utilisation.
· The ability to balance customer expectations, operational requirements, compliance, and commercial objectives.
· A leadership style built around trust, visibility, clarity, and accountability.
· The confidence to make decisions, challenge current thinking, and drive positive change.
· A genuine understanding of drivers and the realities of day-to-day transport operations.
· The ambition to contribute at leadership level and help shape the future direction of a growing business.
Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to join a business where your experience will genuinely matter.
You will:
· Become a key member of the leadership team with genuine ownership and influence.
· Have the freedom to shape and develop the transport function rather than simply maintain it.
· Work in an environment where decisions happen quickly, ideas are encouraged, and performance is recognised.
· Join a company that combines the professionalism and reliability customers expect with the personal service and flexibility that larger competitors often struggle to provide.
· Build meaningful relationships with customers, colleagues, and drivers in a business where people are valued.
· Make a visible difference by improving operations, developing teams, and helping drive continued growth.
If you are an experienced transport professional looking for the next step in your career - a role where your knowledge, leadership, and commercial ability can have a real impact - this offers the opportunity to be part of something ambitious.

job.description:
An opportunity to make your mark in a growing business

Are you a Quantity Surveyor with estimating experience, or an Estimator with strong commercial/QS experience, looking for a role with more variety, responsibility and progression?

This is an opportunity to join an established, family-run building contractor with many years trading history, an excellent reputation across the East Midlands and an exciting pipeline of new work.

The business is growing, winning more contracts and expanding into larger premises. As a result, they are looking for an experienced commercial professional who wants to get stuck in, take ownership and grow with the business.

The Role

This is a genuine 50/50 QS and Estimating role, although the balance will flex with workload.

You'll be involved throughout the project lifecycle, from tendering and estimating through to procurement, commercial management and final accounts, working on projects typically ranging from £25k to £4m. Experience will extend to CVRs, project forecasting and cash flow projections.

Projects include refurbishment, fit-out, alteration, maintenance and new build, across public and private-sector clients.

Key responsibilities

  • Prepare detailed estimates, tender build-ups and pricing submissions.
  • Review drawings, specifications and tender documentation.
  • Obtain, analyse and negotiate subcontractor and supplier quotations.
  • Ability to identify and manage contractual, financial and project risks, scope gaps, exclusions and commercial opportunities.
  • Support tender negotiations, value engineering and public-sector bids.
  • Manage project costs, valuations, variations, forecasting and final accounts.
  • Manage subcontractor packages and commercial negotiations.
  • Procurement of subcontractor and supplier packages.
  • Produce cost-value reconciliations and commercial reports.
  • Build strong relationships with clients, consultants, subcontractors and suppliers.
  • Work closely with Contracts Managers and senior management to manage commercial risks and maximise opportunities.

About you

We're looking for an experienced, commercially minded and hands-on construction professional who can operate with a high degree of autonomy and take ownership of both estimating and commercial management, someone who is comfortable working in an SME environment where everyone gets involved.

You'll ideally have:

  • Experience as a Quantity Surveyor, Estimator or QS/Estimator within a main contractor.
  • Strong estimating/tendering and commercial management experience including post-tender clarifications and negotiations
  • Experience across refurbishment, fit-out, maintenance, alteration and/or new build.
  • Experience with projects broadly within the £25k–£4m range.
  • Strong knowledge of procurement, valuations, variations, cost control, forecasting and final accounts.
  • Experience managing subcontractor packages and supply-chain relationships.
  • Confidence using commercial, estimating and project management systems.
  • Excellent communication and organisational skills.
  • A full UK driving licence.

Public-sector experience is important

Experience working with NHS, healthcare, local authority, education, police, fire or other blue-light/public-sector clients would be highly advantageous.

An understanding of public-sector procurement, frameworks, tenders and SQ/PQQ processes would be particularly useful.

This role is unlikely to suit someone whose experience is purely residential.

Why join?

This is a business where your contribution will be visible.

You'll join a committed, long-standing team within an established company, while also having the opportunity to play a key role in its next stage of growth.

You'll have:

  • Genuine responsibility and autonomy.
  • Exposure to both estimating and commercial management.
  • Direct involvement with senior management.
  • The opportunity to influence project profitability and new contract wins.
  • A supportive, non-corporate working environment.
  • Genuine progression opportunities, including the potential to develop into senior commercial management roles.
  • The opportunity to grow alongside a business that is actively expanding.

The person

We're looking for someone who is ambitious, resilient, results-oriented and commercially sharp, but equally a team player who isn't afraid to roll their sleeves up.

If you're looking for more responsibility, more variety and a genuine opportunity to progress, we'd like to hear from you.

job.title: Quantity Surveyor
job.description:
An opportunity to make your mark in a growing business
Are you a Quantity Surveyor with estimating experience, or an Estimator with strong commercial/QS experience, looking for a role with more variety, responsibility and progression?
This is an opportunity to join an established, family-run building contractor with many years trading history, an excellent reputation across the East Midlands and an exciting pipeline of new work.
The business is growing, winning more contracts and expanding into larger premises. As a result, they are looking for an experienced commercial professional who wants to get stuck in, take ownership and grow with the business.
The Role
This is a genuine 50/50 QS and Estimating role, although the balance will flex with workload.
You'll be involved throughout the project lifecycle, from tendering and estimating through to procurement, commercial management and final accounts, working on projects typically ranging from £25k to £4m. Experience will extend to CVRs, project forecasting and cash flow projections.
Projects include refurbishment, fit-out, alteration, maintenance and new build, across public and private-sector clients.
Key responsibilities
· Prepare detailed estimates, tender build-ups and pricing submissions.
· Review drawings, specifications and tender documentation.
· Obtain, analyse and negotiate subcontractor and supplier quotations.
· Ability to identify and manage contractual, financial and project risks, scope gaps, exclusions and commercial opportunities.
· Support tender negotiations, value engineering and public-sector bids.
· Manage project costs, valuations, variations, forecasting and final accounts.
· Manage subcontractor packages and commercial negotiations.
· Procurement of subcontractor and supplier packages.
· Produce cost-value reconciliations and commercial reports.
· Build strong relationships with clients, consultants, subcontractors and suppliers.
· Work closely with Contracts Managers and senior management to manage commercial risks and maximise opportunities.
About you
We're looking for an experienced, commercially minded and hands-on construction professional who can operate with a high degree of autonomy and take ownership of both estimating and commercial management, someone who is comfortable working in an SME environment where everyone gets involved.
You'll ideally have:
· Experience as a Quantity Surveyor, Estimator or QS/Estimator within a main contractor.
· Strong estimating/tendering and commercial management experience including post-tender clarifications and negotiations
· Experience across refurbishment, fit-out, maintenance, alteration and/or new build.
· Experience with projects broadly within the £25k-£4m range.
· Strong knowledge of procurement, valuations, variations, cost control, forecasting and final accounts.
· Experience managing subcontractor packages and supply-chain relationships.
· Confidence using commercial, estimating and project management systems.
· Excellent communication and organisational skills.
· A full UK driving licence.
Public-sector experience is important
Experience working with NHS, healthcare, local authority, education, police, fire or other blue-light/public-sector clients would be highly advantageous.
An understanding of public-sector procurement, frameworks, tenders and SQ/PQQ processes would be particularly useful.
This role is unlikely to suit someone whose experience is purely residential.
Why join?
This is a business where your contribution will be visible.
You'll join a committed, long-standing team within an established company, while also having the opportunity to play a key role in its next stage of growth.
You'll have:
· Genuine responsibility and autonomy.
· Exposure to both estimating and commercial management.
· Direct involvement with senior management.
· The opportunity to influence project profitability and new contract wins.
· A supportive, non-corporate working environment.
· Genuine progression opportunities, including the potential to develop into senior commercial management roles.
· The opportunity to grow alongside a business that is actively expanding.
The person
We're looking for someone who is ambitious, resilient, results-oriented and commercially sharp, but equally a team player who isn't afraid to roll their sleeves up.
If you're looking for more responsibility, more variety and a genuine opportunity to progress, we'd like to hear from you.
